payload.title: Collapse groups in curation; count groups as one; review the cleanup
payload.description: Curation list collapses a group: one card with "and 5 more" showing the sources, a vote per work or for the group. Same-document copies don't each need a vote. A vote on one copy applies to its copies, and Cyclotron feedback sends one label per work. Reporter pack, ideas and fact-check source strength count a group as one for independence. Story shows coverage. Cleanup of the 310 URL duplicates and 7,237 pending backlog as a reviewed step. Screenshot review before merge.
